verdict.rationale: ScrapingBee documents its own automatic escalation mode: `mode=auto` picks the cheapest configuration that succeeds and escalates through a cost ladder, billing only the successful configuration. This closely matches automatic retry when a request is blocked. However, the evidence does not show what the ladder steps are, so it is unclear whether they are distinct proxy tiers (e.g., standard to premium to stealth). The mode is also limited to GET requests. Missing for 10: the documented contents of the escalation ladder showing distinct proxy types, confirmation that escalation is triggered by anti-bot blocks, support beyond GET, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a data-engineer, I can automatically retry through a chain of different proxies when anti-bot detection blocks a request
